#if str($method.method) == 'volcano': significant = sccellfie.plotting.create_volcano_plot( de_results, effect_threshold=$method.effect_threshold, padj_threshold=$method.padj_threshold, #if str($method.cell_type) != '': cell_type='$method.cell_type', #end if #if str($method.group1) != '': group1='$method.group1', #end if #if str($method.group2) != '': group2='$method.group2', #end if effect_col='$method.effect_col', effect_title='$method.effect_title', save='plot.$method.format', dpi=$method.dpi) print("Significant features:", significant) pd.DataFrame({'significant_features': significant}).to_csv('significant_features.tsv', sep='\t', index=False)

#else if str($method.method) == 'beeswarm': fig, ax, sig_df = sccellfie.plotting.create_beeswarm_plot( de_results, cohen_threshold=$method.cohen_threshold, pval_threshold=$method.pval_threshold, logfc_threshold=$method.logfc_threshold, save='plot.$method.format', dpi=$method.dpi) sig_df.to_csv('significant_features.tsv', sep='\t')
#else if str($method.method) == 'multi_violin': adata = sc.read_h5ad('$method.adata') #set features_list = [str(x.strip()) for x in str($method.features).split(',') if x.strip()] sccellfie.plotting.create_multi_violin_plots( adata, features=$features_list, groupby='$method.groupby', n_cols=$method.n_cols, #if str($method.ylabel) != '': ylabel='$method.ylabel', #end if save='plot.$method.format', dpi=$method.dpi)
#else if str($method.method) == 'radial_plot': metabolic_df = pd.read_csv('$method.metabolic_df', sep='\t') task_info_df = pd.read_csv('$method.task_info_df', sep='\t') sccellfie.plotting.create_radial_plot( metabolic_df, task_info_df, #if str($method.cell_type) != '': cell_type='$method.cell_type', #end if #if str($method.tissue) != '': tissue='$method.tissue', #end if task_col='$method.task_col', category_col='$method.category_col', value_col='$method.value_col', tissue_col='$method.tissue_col', cell_type_col='$method.cell_type_col', sort_by_value=$method.sort_by_value, save='plot.$method.format', dpi=$method.dpi) #end if

tool.help:
.. class:: infomark
**What it does**
Provides scCellFie's downstream visualizations:
- **Volcano plot**: effect size vs. -log10(adjusted p-value) for differential analysis results. - **Comparative violin plot**: compares significant features between two groups for a specific cell type. - **Beeswarm plot**: effect size per cell type (or other grouping) for differential analysis results. - **Grid of violin plots**: violin plots for multiple features across groups. - **Radial plot**: circular bar plot of metabolic task activities grouped by category.
**Input**
- Differential analysis result tables (tabular, from the scCellFie analysis tool) for volcano/beeswarm plots, or AnnData objects (``.h5ad``) for violin plots, or the melted table from the summary report of the scCellFie pipeline tool together with the corresponding task information table (both tabular) for radial plots.
**Output**
- A plot image (PNG, PDF, or SVG). - For the beeswarm plot, the list of significant features as a tabular file.
